proposed_widenings.name: conditional_activated_grant_during_duration
proposed_widenings.justification: The item already fits the magic-item activation family except that its timed benefit is only active while the bearer is peering through the gem. The current surface can gate a whole passive or activation with `peering_through_item`, but it cannot express a 10-minute activated window whose carried effect is conditionally active only while that predicate holds.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "For the next 10 minutes, you have Truesight out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem."

notes: Did not author Dhall or runtime JSON because the honest encoding gap is effect-level conditional activity within an activated timed window. Encoding as an unconditional 10-minute `grant_sense` would overstate the rule.
